settings.title: What is a solitaire ring?
settings.answer: A solitaire ring showcases a single diamond at the center of the band, highlighting the brilliance and fire of the center stone. Its minimalist design is a perfect choice for special moments in life, symbolizing enduring love, commitment, and personal expression. Whether buying an engagement, anniversary ring, or a gift to yourself, a solitaire ring captures what resonates most in your heart.

settings.title: How do I choose the right solitaire ring?
settings.answer: When it comes to a solitaire ring, diamonds are often assessed using the 4Cs: carat weight, cut, clarity, and color. These elements define the diamond's quality and appearance. Pair your choice with a band that complements your finger shape and size, and choose a metal—such as classic yellow gold or refined white gold—that enhances your skin tone. For further guidance, explore our comprehensive guide on the lab-grown diamond 4Cs.

settings.title: What is the best diamond shape for a solitaire ring?
settings.answer: While round diamonds are a timeless classic, those seeking a unique style can explore options like asscher, emerald, pear, marquise, cushion, and oval, which offer sleek lines and geometric beauty with simplicity. These unique shapes create a striking look and may even elongate the appearance of your fingers, offering a beautiful addition to any collection. Note that step cuts are evaluated differently and do not have formal cut grades.

settings.title: What is the best size for a solitaire ring?
settings.answer: The perfect carat size for your solitaire ring is ultimately a reflection of your personal style and preferences. Understanding how different sizes fit various finger sizes and shapes can help you make a suitable and informed decision. Our ring size guide is available to assist you in finding the ideal fit.

settings.title: Do you offer ring resizing?
settings.answer: Yes, we provide complimentary resizing for select items within 30 days, covering shipping both ways. Typically, we can resize a ring by half or one full size. Resizing beyond this limit may compromise the ring's structural integrity. Also, please note that eternity and pavé rings cannot be resized due to the delicate nature of the stones.

settings.title: How does the setting affect my solitaire ring?
settings.answer: The setting is crucial to your solitaire ring's appearance and durability. A prong setting maximizes light return for enhanced sparkle, while a halo setting makes the diamond appear larger with a surrounding circle of smaller diamonds. Bezel settings offer robust protection by fully encasing the stone, while prong settings are also secure but should be checked regularly.

settings.title: How does the height of the setting affect the ring's wearability and stackability?
settings.answer:
• High Setting: Prominent, easier to stack, but may snag.
  • Low Setting: Comfortable, less snagging, but can create gaps.
  • Flush Setting: Lowest profile for comfort, but limited stacking; often requires custom fitting.

settings.title: Do you offer engraving services for your solitaire rings?
settings.answer: Yes, we provide complimentary engraving for select items to personalize your solitaire ring with a special message or date. Please note that engraving typically adds 1-2 business days to the production timeline.

settings.title: What makes solitaire rings so special?
settings.answer: Diamond solitaires are timeless and versatile, making them an ideal choice for engagement rings or for everyday wear. They can be worn alone or beautifully stacked with minimalist eternity bands. For a more unique look, consider styles like a halo, toi et moi, or a three-stone design.
